result.topic_en: A very faint page of a letter, apparently signed K. Hattendorff, about publishing material related to Riemann's work. It mentions Schwarz, Schondorff's treatise (Abhandlung), Weierstrass, Dedekind and a Riemann item to be enclosed, and asks the recipient to decide on an introduction to the printing.
